description: Moto tours and enduro motorcycle rentals in Dalat: Powerful bikes, excellent offroad tires, and locations that are inaccessible to regular transportation. We operate all year round and offer training for beginners | Enduro-Vietnam

children.text: Our bases are located in key locations across Vietnam, providing rental and support services wherever you need them.
We have conducted hundreds of tours and know the safest and most exciting routes in the country
DIRT BIKE RENTAL FOR OFF-ROAD ADVENTURES
WHAT ARE THE MOTORCYCLE TOURS IN DALAT:

This enduro tour is your ticket to the heart of the "Vietnamese Alps," where you'll find cool coniferous forests and misty highlands in Dalat instead of the scorching beach heat. You'll ride along red dirt trails at the foot of Mount Langbiang, tackle steep climbs through pine forests, and explore hidden coffee plantations accessible only through wild off-road paths. The panoramic views are cinematic, from the mirror-like Lake Tuyen Lam to the endless ranges of the "Cloud Mountains."

The route takes you through authentic ethnic minority villages and steep forest clearings. Experienced instructors will guide you through the tricky terrain, helping you navigate slippery surfaces and confidently tackle the mountain passes, providing you with a thrilling and controlled riding experience. This is a concentrated blend of mountain freshness, technical riding, and the rugged beauty of the central highlands. It's an enduro challenge that will change the way you perceive Vietnam!
Booking confirmation: record at least 2 days in advance. The organizer will confirm the booking for the date you have chosen, after which you will make a 30% prepayment.

Three-Day Tour of Dalat and Mui Ne

The journey from the highlands of Dalat to the coast of Mui Ne is so epic that it demands a full three-day immersion. This isn't just a ride; it’s a legendary transition across Vietnam’s most diverse landscapes. We’ve designed a route that starts in the cool, misty pine forests of the Central Highlands and leads you straight into the heart of the red and white desert dunes.

You’ll navigate through high-altitude coffee plantations, tackle technical mountain passes, and descend through wild tropical jungles to reach the sea breeze. Over three days, you will face challenging terrains and hidden trails that most travelers never even see. From river crossings to the vast freedom of the desert sands, this is a total rush of adrenaline and honest extreme. This three-day adventure happens once in a lifetime — book your spot and experience the real driving soul of Vietnam!
Booking confirmation: record at least 2 days in advance. The organizer will confirm the booking for the date you have chosen, after which you will make a 30% prepayment.
Easy Rider - Enduro Route for Beginners

The surroundings of Dalat are so diverse that one day is simply not enough to master the art of off-road riding. We’ve designed a two-day Easy Rider course that combines intensive training with a breathtaking journey. From the mirror-like Suoi Vang Lake to the hidden Tyam Tyam Waterfall, you will learn to ride where others wouldn't dare to walk.

Forget the stress of city traffic. You’ll practice gear shifting and clutch control while navigating through picturesque coffee plantations and pine forest trails. This itinerary is built to gradually increase in complexity, allowing you to tackle your first steep inclines and rocky paths with confidence. It’s not just a lesson; it’s a full immersion into the wild highlands. Gain real skills, feel absolute freedom, and discover a Vietnam you won't find in any guidebook. Your journey into the world of Enduro starts here!
Booking confirmation: record at least 2 days in advance. The organizer will confirm the booking for the date you have chosen, after which you will make a 30% prepayment.

We decided to go on this enduro tour to Dalat together with my father. He has a lot of motorcycle riding experience, and I have almost zero. Honestly, I was very worried that without the skills, the whole trip would go down the drain. But in reality, everything turned out differently: in just 1-2 hours, Andrey "put" me behind the wheel, sorted out the basics and subtleties of driving.

In the remaining time, we really went for it — we rode through the jungle, rocky trails, off-road, hills, and mountain slopes of the Central Highlands. We both had a great time, and this adventure set the tone for our entire trip to Vietnam! 😊 I would especially like to mention Andrey's coaching skills — he is an expert in working with beginners and truly opened up the magical world of enduro to my father and me. I highly recommend it to anyone seeking adrenaline in the cool heights of Dalat!

My wife, Yulia, gave me this tour as a birthday present, knowing how much I love motorcycles. She had only a couple of hours of experience on a cross-country track, so she was really nervous for the first three days of the tour. I'm not a professional enduro rider either. However, Boris, the coach (yes, he's a coach, as this is more of a training session with adventure elements than just a trip), didn't seem to mind our lack of experience.

He spent at least an hour on the training ground to get a person back on their feet, and by the way, Yulia even drove on her own, albeit only in a straight line ;) In the end, Boris made a bold decision: he took Yulia as his second rider on his bike. Together, we covered about 60 km of rough terrain, including rocks, ditches, and steep inclines and descents in the vicinity of Dalat. To be honest, at times it seemed that the next obstacle was physically impossible to overcome, but seeing how easily Boris handled it (and with a passenger!), I was inspired and followed suit. Of course, the equipment and gear took a beating... Every second of this route will be etched in my memory forever, and my casual interaction with Boris left a lasting positive impression. The final "finishing touch" was a personal gift from him! It touched me to the core! This outing to the cool heights of Dalat is worth more than any price — the memories are priceless! I recommend it to all couples seeking adrenaline and a connection with nature. 😊

Do you provide any toolboxes, wheel repair kits, or a minimum set of tools?
Here is the information on each item:
-Coffers: Unfortunately, there are no cofers. For long-distance trips, we have experience in securely securing luggage on the trunk using slings.
-Wheel repair kit and a minimum set of tools:
Since we mainly drive around the vicinity of Da Lat (and even when traveling on longer routes), we rely on the availability of local tire shops, where repairs can be completed within 10-30 minutes.
However, if it is crucial for your peace of mind, we can provide a minimum set of tools and a wheel repair kit.

Experience: We always recommend to take a rope with you on a trip. In our practice, there were cases (for example, a chain break) when this helped to easily tow the motorcycle to the nearest repair service without difficulties.
Where are we going? Only in Dalat?
We ride in the picturesque surroundings of Dalat itself and in all locations of the Central Highlands around the city. We know the best trails for any level.
We start rolling from the very morning, from about 7:00, and we work until dark, around 18:00. You can choose a rental of any duration, up to a full day.
Can I drive if I don't have any driving experience?

Of course! We train everyone, regardless of age or gender. In just one day of training, you will learn the mechanics and be able to drive confidently on your own. We guarantee that you will be able to drive⚡️
What equipment is included in the price?

The rental price includes a motorcycle (enduro) and a protective helmet. We recommend that you wear comfortable, closed-toe shoes that you don't mind getting dirty. Also, wear comfortable shoes with laces. Slippers won't do.
Do I need an international driving license to ride an enduro bike?

Although a license is formally required, Dalat is an enduro tourist center. The Vietnamese authorities in our area do not stop tourists on enduro motorcycles. We can ride safely without worrying about it💫
What should be left as collateral?
You can either leave a deposit of 200💲 or use your passport as a guarantee for minor repairs.
Who pays for motorcycle breakdowns or damages?
Anything that happens due to the client's fault (falls, damage) is paid by the client upon repair.
Can you provide any city-related advice (other than rental)?
Absolutely! We will be happy to be your local guide. We will tell you about interesting places to visit👀, delicious places to eat🍔, bars to visit🍻, and current events to attend💃🕺
Does the Tour around Dalat include a visit to the waterfalls?

Of course! Our routes include the coolest natural spots in Dalat. We often drive right next to the iconic Datanla and Elephant Waterfalls, as well as take a look at Kau Dat Tea Hill. We can even stop by Chuk Lam Monastery for a quick overview. It will be an unforgettable Tour of the surroundings of Dalat! 🏞️🏍️
Do you only organize enduro tours, or are there other adventures?

First of all, we are experts in enduro motorcycles and off-roading. But if you want even more extreme, for example, to try the Dalat Canyoning Tour (this is a descent through waterfalls!), we will definitely recommend our trusted and reliable partners. 🧗👍
Is it possible to combine an enduro tour with a coffee tour?

Yes, this is a great idea! We will be happy to include the elements of the Dalat Coffee Tour in your itinerary. You will not only see the coffee plantations, but also ride through them on a bike and, of course, taste the famous Vietnamese coffee right on the spot. Everything is flexible with us! ☕🌿
How is your Enduro Tour (Easy Rider) different from Enduro Tour+?

The difference is huge! An Enduro Tour (Easy Rider) is when you're being driven by a guide. Our tour is your personal adrenaline rush! You're in control of the dirt bike (Enduro), and we'll tackle the most challenging off-road trails together. It's an active, self-paced adventure! 🤘🚦
What is the weather in Dalat by month? When is the best time to go, considering the rainy season?

The weather in Dalat, especially during the rainy season, can be changeable. It rains quite often, but we have a secret! According to our statistics, on 5 out of 7 days, there is no rain from morning to noon. This is an ideal, clear window to explore the best trails and experience the adrenaline rush. We recommend starting early! 🌥️👍
Do you only rent out enduro motorcycles, or do you also rent out motocross motorcycles?

Our main focus is, of course, on enduro motorcycles for off-roading. We don't rent out cross-country motorcycles ourselves, but we can connect you with our Vietnamese colleagues who offer them. Just keep in mind that the price is higher there. Anything you want for your money! Do you want an outdoor kitchen or a barbecue? Just ask! 😉💸

Of course! We train everyone, regardless of age or gender. In just one day of training, you will learn the mechanics and be able to drive confidently on your own. We guarantee that you will be able to drive⚡️
What equipment is included in the price?

The rental price includes a motorcycle (enduro) and a protective helmet. We recommend that you wear comfortable, closed-toe shoes that you don't mind getting dirty. Also, wear comfortable shoes with laces. Slippers won't do.
Do I need an international driving license to ride an enduro bike?

Although a license is formally required, Dalat is an enduro tourist center. The Vietnamese authorities in our area do not stop tourists on enduro motorcycles. We can ride safely without worrying about it💫
What should be left as collateral?
You can either leave a deposit of 200💲 or use your passport as a guarantee for minor repairs.
Who pays for motorcycle breakdowns or damages?
Anything that happens due to the client's fault (falls, damage) is paid by the client upon repair.
Can you provide any city-related advice (other than rental)?
Absolutely! We will be happy to be your local guide. We will tell you about interesting places to visit👀, delicious places to eat🍔, bars to visit🍻, and current events to attend💃🕺
Does the Tour around Dalat include a visit to the waterfalls?

Of course! Our routes include the coolest natural spots in Dalat. We often drive right next to the iconic Datanla and Elephant Waterfalls, as well as take a look at Kau Dat Tea Hill. We can even stop by Chuk Lam Monastery for a quick overview. It will be an unforgettable Tour of the surroundings of Dalat! 🏞️🏍️
Do you only organize enduro tours, or are there other adventures?

First of all, we are experts in enduro motorcycles and off-roading. But if you want even more extreme, for example, to try the Dalat Canyoning Tour (this is a descent through waterfalls!), we will definitely recommend our trusted and reliable partners. 🧗👍
Is it possible to combine an enduro tour with a coffee tour?

Yes, this is a great idea! We will be happy to include the elements of the Dalat Coffee Tour in your itinerary. You will not only see the coffee plantations, but also ride through them on a bike and, of course, taste the famous Vietnamese coffee right on the spot. Everything is flexible with us! ☕🌿
How is your Enduro Tour (Easy Rider) different from Enduro Tour+?

The difference is huge! An Enduro Tour (Easy Rider) is when you're being driven by a guide. Our tour is your personal adrenaline rush! You're in control of the dirt bike (Enduro), and we'll tackle the most challenging off-road trails together. It's an active, self-paced adventure! 🤘🚦
What is the weather in Dalat by month? When is the best time to go, considering the rainy season?

The weather in Dalat, especially during the rainy season, can be changeable. It rains quite often, but we have a secret! According to our statistics, on 5 out of 7 days, there is no rain from morning to noon. This is an ideal, clear window to explore the best trails and experience the adrenaline rush. We recommend starting early! 🌥️👍
Do you only rent out enduro motorcycles, or do you also rent out motocross motorcycles?

Our main focus is, of course, on enduro motorcycles for off-roading. We don't rent out cross-country motorcycles ourselves, but we can connect you with our Vietnamese colleagues who offer them. Just keep in mind that the price is higher there. Anything you want for your money! Do you want an outdoor kitchen or a barbecue? Just ask! 😉💸
